description: Cambio - stations et véhicules partagés is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Cambio. A des fins de recherche, partenaires ou personnes intéressées (le format de fichier est JSON et les caractères sur cette page sont UITF-8) 1) Aperçu de toutes les stations avec leurs coordonnées, adresse, brève description et voitures disponibles 2) Aperçu de tous les modèles de voitures. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal lists 3 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are cambio, mobilité, voitur, partager. The portal shows 18 records. The portal shows 2024-12-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
